LearningModules.title: Junior Data modelling and storage - Module 1: Guided implementation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:
In Data modelling and storage, demonstrate the following junior tasks:
MS-DE01: Create an entity model from supplied requirements; verify keys and relationships against sample records.
MS-DE03: Build and load a small warehouse using a supplied schema and reconcile source-to-target counts.
MS-DE06: Fill a supplied data dictionary with field meanings, owners and structural metadata.
Submit evidence:
MS-DE01: Model diagram, schema, constraint checks and design rationale.
MS-DE03: Warehouse schema, load scripts, history tests and reconciliation results.
MS-DE06: Data dictionary, ownership records, change history and review findings.

LearningModules.title: Junior Data modelling and storage - Module 2: Guided validation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:
In Data modelling and storage, demonstrate the following junior tasks:
MS-DE13: Measure a supplied warehouse query before and after one guided optimisation; confirm unchanged results.
MS-DE16: Identify downstream consumers of a supplied dataset change using existing lineage information.
Submit evidence:
MS-DE13: Workload definition, before/after measurements, result reconciliation and decision record.
MS-DE16: Dependency map, affected-consumer list, assumptions and change verification results.

Submit evidence:
MS-DE02: Runnable application, input/output fixtures, test results and execution logs.
MS-DE04: Mapping document, sample transformations, exception decisions and validation results.
MS-DE08: Flow diagram, contracts, failure scenarios and design decisions.
